answer.new_information: SemiAnalysis's claim that the planned NVL72x2 alternative design was scrapped repeats the same cancellation claim in e101; the Decoder is relaying SemiAnalysis, not an independent source. This concerns the NVL72x2 alternative, not the launch timing or status of Kyber NVL144 itself. It supplies no new evidence about whether Kyber will launch by 2027-12-31 or 2028-12-31, so it does not change either question's current argument.
